content: Jisas nono opa gale awi iwa kerman moro

Juda una opa gale awinj una kerman kambono mor ge, God dje worika ga lotu yene mal kambono ge, una pille God kogoye yei. Juda una yenekne singare ke yei ge, God i worda dje pille opa gale God awo, wal iwo God awo embe yei.

Ba una yembene naparo mal embe, Juda una opa gale awi una kerman mor ge, ga para yembene naparo. Ge pille, una nomane pa kune nayenda er take dje pine mor ge, ga kambono boll kandja kosilleba dje aune kune yendo.
Ga yembene napai pille, Juda una singare ke yene ge, ga opa gale awo, yenekne pille para opa gale awo embe yene.

Opa gale awi una kerman mor ge kandjine paro. Yenekne kogo embe yembon dje piye ba ge kune nayenda. God djindaka ga kogo embe yene. God dje wori Aron opa gale awi mal embe, God dje worda kambono ge embe moye.
Embe mal ge, Krais na opa gale awi iwa kerman moyo, na kandjina kerman panda we nadji, man. God yene dje wori Krais po kogo ge yei. God embe dji,

content.text: Ni na warna moren Ipon na ni nan moro we dji (Buk Song 2.7)

content: Baibel tambiye ta pai al ge God embe dji,

content.text: Ege ege, ni opa gale awi una mopen, pora nadjinda. Iwa Melkisedek opa gale awi una moi mal embe mopen (Buk Song 110.4)

content: Jisas makimb al moi kune ge, une kamang ye God awi. Na nagoyo, God na i yem djinda dje kane, yau to, kimb ye, kimb nuye boll kamang ye God awi. Ba yene molo kal woro kandja eske pi pille une kamang yei ge God awi.
Une God wariye kaima moi ba, imb kerman kaki. Kaki al ge, une ombine dji ge, God dji mal ye kune yei.
Embe pille, God kandja dji mal kune kaima yeika, une kandja djinda mal karkar yene una ge, er take dje napine, une i yem djindaka, ege ege molo pane.
Alla, God dje pene woro embe dji, Melkisedek opa gale awi iwa moi mal ge, Jisas embe moi we dji.
Pillgi djinmon ge poriye namopon, yake pla bon
Melkisedek moi mal ge, Jisas embe moi we dje kandja embe djinmon ge, no ye boll kandja merke djimbon ba, ye nomane kull pi, no yembe ke yembon ba ye ola dje pille ine naparo.
Ye kamasa pillgi dji, ye una kandja beke aune mal pai ba, ge man. God kandjiye, ye kandja me asamoll pi ge, una wo ye alla beke aune paro. Ye kwa dongall nanonj, ye am no pamor.
Una am no pamor ge, womba mal embe molo par, singare du dje paro ge, pille kane nayenj.
Ba iwana dongall mor ge, kwa dongall nonj. Singare ke ne, wopake paro ge, kun merke ye omuk to kane, singare wopake yenj.
